newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle market slow - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle market slow - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, compared to Fridays close, USDA said.
Trade was slow and demand light to moderate. Seller interest light. Offerings light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared Fridays close - Slaughter steers and heifers not well established.
